description: Add nullable run_id, node_id, node_type and edge_condition to harness_eval so a graph node's decision can be scored independently of the task it ran under, plus (run_id, node_id) and (node_type, created_at) indexes (hgx-eval-01).
author: icdev-builder
reversible_note: down.py drops the four columns and both indexes; any per-node correlation already recorded is lost because run/node identity is stored nowhere else.
